title: Wall St ends mixed as investors parse Middle East negotiations
title_zh: 随着投资者解析中东谈判，华尔街收盘涨跌互现
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks closed mixed on Friday, with the Dow dropping more than half a percent, the S&P 500 ticking down marginally and the Nasdaq adding more than a third of a percent - its 8th straight day of gains.U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周五收盘涨跌不一，道琼斯指数下跌逾半个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数小幅下跌，纳斯达克指数上涨逾三分之一 - 连续第八天上涨。

title: Wall Street Banks Try Out Anthropic’s Mythos as US Urges
title_zh: 在美国的敦促下，华尔街银行尝试了人类的神话
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Wall Street banks are starting to test Anthropic PBC’s Mythos model internally as Trump administration officials encourage them to use it to detect vulnerabilities.While JPMorgan Chase & Co.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——随着特朗普政府官员鼓励华尔街银行使用 Anthropic PBC 的 Mythos 模型来检测漏洞，华尔街银行开始在内部测试 Anthropic PBC 的 Mythos 模型。

title: Tesla's supervised self-driving software gets Dutch okay, first in Europe
title_zh: 特斯拉的受监督自动驾驶软件在荷兰获得认可，成为欧洲首个
summary: Dutch regulators approved the use of Tesla's self-driving software with required human supervision on highways and city streets in a European first for the electric ‌car maker, which hopes to see similar action from the rest of the European Union.
summary_zh: 荷兰监管机构批准在高速公路和城市街道上使用特斯拉的自动驾驶软件，并进行必要的人工监督，这对于这家电动汽车制造商来说在欧洲尚属首次，该公司希望看到欧盟其他国家也采取类似行动。

title: Why Alphabet is a 'really misunderstood story' for investors
title_zh: 为什么 Alphabet 对于投资者来说是一个“真正被误解的故事”
summary: Yahoo Finance's "Market Madness" bracket tournament is rounding out its Final Four pairings, as Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) prepares to go head-to-head with Walmart (WMT) to determine who will be competing with Amazon (AMZN) in the finals.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的“市场疯狂”分组赛即将结束其四强对决，Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）准备与沃尔玛（WMT）正面交锋，以确定谁将在决赛中与亚马逊（AMZN）竞争。

title: CoreWeave stock surges on multiyear AI deal with Anthropic
title_zh: CoreWeave 股价因与 Anthropic 达成多年人工智能协议而飙升
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) and Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) have partnered on a multiyear cloud deal. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley goes over the details.
summary_zh: CoreWeave (CRWV) 和 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 已就一项多年云协议展开合作。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 详细介绍了这些细节。

title: How OpenAI's reported ad plans could change the AI business model
title_zh: OpenAI 报告的广告计划如何改变人工智能商业模式
summary: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) is reportedly projecting $100 billion in advertising revenue by 2030. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains how this could shift the artificial intelligence (AI) business model.
summary_zh: 据报道，OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 预计到 2030 年广告收入将达到 1000 亿美元。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 解释了这将如何改变人工智能 (AI) 商业模式。

title: Tesla stock mired in 8-week losing streak as investors search for catalysts
title_zh: 由于投资者寻找催化剂，特斯拉股价陷入八周连跌
summary: Tesla stock is poised to drop for the eight week in a row, as its rough 2026 start rolls on. This as first quarter earnings are coming later this month.
summary_zh: 随着 2026 年艰难开局的到来，特斯拉股价预计将连续八周下跌。第一季度财报将于本月晚些时候公布。

title: Meta stock is still 'dirt cheap' despite Muse Spark rally
title_zh: 尽管 Muse Spark 反弹，Meta 股票仍然“非常便宜”
summary: Meta (META) released artificial intelligence (AI) model Muse Spark on Wednesday, triggering a stock rally this week.
summary_zh: Meta（META）周三发布人工智能（AI）模型Muse Spark，引发本周股市上涨。

title: CoreWeave stock climbs 10% on Anthropic deal
title_zh: Anthropic 交易推动 CoreWeave 股价上涨 10%
summary: Anthropic and CoreWeave have entered into a new agreement that will see CoreWeave's AI infrastructure power Anthropic's various models.
summary_zh: Anthropic 和 CoreWeave 已达成一项新协议，CoreWeave 的人工智能基础设施将为 Anthropic 的各种模型提供支持。
